PullRequest.Title: sessions: Continue archiving when onboarding is interrupted
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary

- Let **Archive / Mark as Done** continue when the optional session-list introduction is aborted or dismissed, rather than reporting that the introduction was interrupted.
- Keep the introduction eligible to retry later, while preserving session revalidation and actual archive/provider error reporting.
- Add regression coverage for interrupted onboarding, subsequent archive failures, and stale suggestions, and update accessibility help.

## Why

The first-use spotlight can abort when its target is unavailable or invisible, the presentation fails, or the window starts shutting down. That optional introduction should not prevent the requested archive operation while the session remains eligible.

## Validation

- Client compilation: `npm run gulp compile-client` - 0 errors.
- Repository hygiene passed for all three changed files.
- 79 tests passed across the session archive nudge, chat archive nudge widget, and spotlight presentation suites.

Scenarios.Scenario: First-use Archive / Mark as Done after onboarding completes or is skipped
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The click awaits showArchiveOnboarding, including opening/revealing the Sessions view and completing the spotlight, then revalidates the suggestion and awaits one provider archive. This path and ordering are unchanged by the diff.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Persist onboarding memento state when an outcome is not completed or skipped.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The reset was already present and completed/skipped outcomes did not call it.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Persist one session archived-state change through its provider; agent-host providers dispatch one state action.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One archive operation for the selected session; the widget's archiving flag disables repeat activation while pending.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Completed/skipped onboarding already proceeded to this same single provider archive.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited after onboarding before the requested action completes.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One selected session and its optional single detached worktree; no collection fan-out. Concurrent UI activation is prevented by ChatSessionArchiveNudge.archiving.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The onboarding service coalesces one in-flight scenario, and the widget serializes archive activation. Provider work is one operation for one session.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Provider and session lookups use existing in-memory collections; no new cache key, cold fetch, cache bypass, or negative-cache behavior is introduced.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the unchanged call chain and UI serialization are directly visible in the implementation.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider latency varies, especially if a remote detached worktree must be cleaned, but the diff does not change this successful path.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression: the diff does not alter work, boundaries, or ordering for completed/skipped onboarding.

Scenarios.Scenario: First-use Archive / Mark as Done when onboarding is aborted or dismissed
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The click already waited for the onboarding attempt and reset its shown state. The diff removes the terminal error, so it now revalidates the suggestion and performs the single archive operation the user requested. The archive remains on the action's critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Delete the scenario's shown state and save the application memento.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One reset for the interrupted first-use attempt.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The base code reset the same memento and then threw.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Runs synchronously before archiving, as it did before the diff.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Dispatch one SessionIsArchivedChanged action to the owning agent host for agent-host-backed sessions.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one dispatch for the selected session from the UI action.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The interrupted outcome threw before provider dispatch, so the requested archive did not occur.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The dispatch is initiated during the archive action; it is newly reached after aborted/dismissed onboarding.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: For the remote-agent provider only, send one extension request to update an optional detached worktree's archived state before dispatching the session state change.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero when the selected session has no detached worktree; otherwise one request for its one handle.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No worktree request occurred after interrupted onboarding because control threw first.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited by archiveSession and therefore by the click.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: For a detached worktree, update metadata and inspect/optionally commit and remove that worktree during the archive operation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One worktree for the selected session; git/filesystem steps are serialized per handle.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: This requested archive cleanup was skipped when onboarding aborted or was dismissed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited only for the remote detached-worktree provider variant.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: A single user-selected session and at most its single detached worktree. Cost may scale with that worktree's repository state and cleanup duration, not with the number of sessions or pull requests.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One archive action at a time per widget because the button and related controls are disabled while archiving. Onboarding requests are also coalesced. Detached-worktree cleanup is sequenced per handle.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The suggestion state and provider session are already resident. Reset intentionally leaves onboarding eligible for a later session; this matches the pre-diff interrupted-outcome behavior. No cache invalidation or repeated cold read is added.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the removed throw directly makes one provider archive reachable, and provider variants establish the exact boundaries and cardinality.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Git cleanup can be slow for a large worktree, but it is the explicit archive operation requested by the user and occurs only once; there is no evidence of fan-out or accidental repetition.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression: the added boundary work is the necessary one-shot implementation of the requested archive, remains bounded to one session/worktree, and is serialized by the UI and provider.

Scenarios.Scenario: Onboarding finishes after the archive suggestion becomes stale
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After any completed, aborted, or dismissed outcome, _getArchiveState rechecks current observable state before provider dispatch. If the session became active, disconnected, loading, archived, or otherwise ineligible, execution rejects before archiveSession.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One selected session; eligibility reads its chats and workspace folders already represented in memory.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The in-flight onboarding promise is coalesced, and stale revalidation prevents downstream provider work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache or boundary access is added; revalidation uses current observables and existing pull-request models.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the call order and regression tests directly prove the guard precedes archive.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material to performance; the tests explicitly cover all three outcomes and assert zero archive targets.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression: stale actions do not newly trigger provider, filesystem, or IPC work.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: The provider appends one revised localized paragraph when the archive-nudge setting is enabled; this is synchronous string assembly during explicit accessibility-help generation.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Constant one localized string per help-content generation.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous, single invocation; no queue or parallelism.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Only an existing configuration read is performed; no cache behavior changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the diff only changes static localized text.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material; the text length increase is constant and small.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression: the runtime cost remains constant and negligible.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed all three changed files and traced the removed interruption throw through the archive nudge UI, onboarding persistence, session management, agent-host/Copilot/remote providers, and detached-worktree cleanup. The only newly reached expensive work is one user-requested archive after aborted or dismissed onboarding; it is bounded to one session, guarded against duplicate UI activation, and provider work is serialized where needed. No high-confidence actionable performance issue or performance-regression fix was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
